stations.title: Radio log
stations.text: Prints as object at 0x and a number

stations.title: Rhona
stations.note: Every call reads as a line.

captions: At the radio desk, Ailsa asks whether Charlie has called in tonight.
Today the log prints a row of object at 0x and numbers, and nobody can read it.
You teach a call to print, to know itself typed twice, to sort, and the log to answer.
Now Charlie's call reads as a line of the log, at its place in the night.
The log prints, compares and sorts itself, and Rhona reads the night in order.
